name: Java 21+ / Spring Boot 3
description: Backend governance for Java 21+, Spring Boot 3 REST/gRPC services, constructor injection, Bean Validation, DTO boundaries, and Maven/Gradle verification.
verification_commands: ./mvnw test  # Maven projects (or ./gradlew test for Gradle projects)

evaluators.name: Java 21+ / Spring Boot Architecture, Security & Data Evaluator
evaluators.scope: Constructor injection, Bean Validation (@Valid), immutable DTO boundaries without entity exposure, Spring Security authz/CSRF rules, @Transactional scope, and MockMvc/Testcontainers tests.

pr_checklist: Controllers accept and return validated DTOs (`@Valid`, Java `record`s) and never expose raw JPA entities
Spring beans use constructor injection (zero field `@Autowired`) with explicit `@Transactional` service boundaries
Spring Boot test suite (`./mvnw test` or `./gradlew test`) passes
agents_md_rules: **Java & Spring Boot Standards:** Follow [`.agents/skills/backend-java-spring/SKILL.md`](.agents/skills/backend-java-spring/SKILL.md) (Java 21+, Spring Boot 3, constructor injection, `@Valid` DTO boundaries, `@Transactional` hygiene, `./mvnw test` / `./gradlew test`).

steps.name: Build and run Spring Boot tests
steps.run: if [ -f pom.xml ]; then if [ -x ./mvnw ]; then ./mvnw -B test; elif [ -f mvnw ]; then chmod +x mvnw && ./mvnw -B test; elif command -v mvn >/dev/null 2>&1; then mvn -B test; else echo 'Error: pom.xml found but neither ./mvnw nor mvn is available.' >&2; exit 1; fi; elif [ -f build.gradle ] || [ -f build.gradle.kts ]; then if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then ./gradlew test --no-daemon; elif [ -f gradlew ]; then chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew test --no-daemon; elif command -v gradle >/dev/null 2>&1; then gradle test --no-daemon; else echo 'Error: Gradle build file found but neither ./gradlew nor gradle is available.' >&2; exit 1; fi; fi
